origin: Numerical inputs used by the report, exported without modification.

notes.baselines.json: Monte Carlo, mean propagation, Gaussian covariance and estimator comparisons on fresh networks 700 and 701. Error arrays subtract an estimated reference sampling floor; small negative entries are not clipped.
notes.gate.json: Saved scalar-gate and marginal illustration data; these are offline research quantities.
notes.physics.json: Statistics for 64 fresh networks 700 through 763, from the report's W24j/native-policy captures and Monte Carlo moments. They are not a second AIcrowd grade of the adaptive final package.
notes.story.json: Saved distributions and explanatory statistics used by the report; not graded predictions.
notes.stock_ops_xfin.json: One local stock execution's operator counts and timing breakdown; component evidence about this execution, not a universal machine-time model.

reproduction_boundary: These files permit inspection and replotting of the report inputs. Complete training corpora, Monte Carlo banks and original capture jobs are not distributed.
